assertions.name: c3_habiro_3rung_tracks_empirical_across_anchors
assertions.source: Whether the real-q 3-rung [3]_q/25 formula reproduces empirical c_3 at BOTH the proton and muon anchors (genuine fibre rigidity) vs. matching only at the proton anchor (near-match). Expected False — a smooth real-q form cannot track the ~4.6e6 dc_3/dq of the hyper-sensitive extracted c_3.

data.interpretation: The real-q 3-rung [3]_q/25 c_3 closure swings +6.18e-07% across the two anchors while empirical c_3 swings -2.88% (ratio -2.15e-07). The formula is RIGID; it reproduces empirical c_3 only at the proton anchor (miss -2.97% at muon). This CONFIRMS [3]_q/25 is a proton-anchor NEAR-MATCH, not a real-q fibre element — consistent with the known impossibility of a real-q c_3=f(q) matching multiple anchors (AGENTS.md). The genuine Habiro element, if it exists, is complex-analytic / root-of-unity. Falsification test; no fit, no production change.
